card.name: Product size and presentation wording
card.fires_on: Words naming a product's size, strength or presentation (Size, presentations, dosage form, needle length) in preparation or supply sections. Also fires on the end of a number or unit in product package listings.

modes.label: Size or presentation words
modes.description: The word names the size, form or presentation of a vial, pen or needle.
modes.example: Vial<< Size>> Amount of Diluent Added (mL

modes.label: Package count or needle gauge
modes.description: Digits or marks inside a pack count, product name number or needle measurement.

card.plain: It fires on words that describe how a product is sized or packaged, such as vial size, needle length and dosage form.
